status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Engine 1.0.0 and the site comparison are inlined into server.mjs. The engine was published to npm on 2026-10-11 under the latest tag; the bundle is built from the archive whose SHA-256 is below, which npm's tarball matches. The adapter is an unpublished candidate. Bundling keeps one copy of the comparison rules.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

computeApi.note: The hosted compute API's parsers and positions, events, sky-fact and time calculations, inlined into server.mjs, so get_positions, find_events, check_sky_fact and resolve_birth_time return what POST https://zodiacs.org/api/v1/positions, /events, /sky-fact and /time return for the same request. The first three take no zone; resolve_birth_time reads its zone with the engine's geo entry and the zone histories the engine ships, which server.mjs carries.

places.note: The site's birthplace index, which scripts/build-cities.mjs builds and the site's calculators fetch, inlined into server.mjs for search_places with the ranking the site's search uses.

timeAtlas.name: Zodiacs.org historical time atlas
timeAtlas.note: The engine repository's atlas data, copied byte for byte, and its resolver (atlas/tools/lib.mjs, MIT) with only its loader changed, inlined into server.mjs for resolve_birth_time's atlasPlace.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard. The record and receipt schemas are drafts.

changedSince: 0.1.0-rc.24 adds two tools. resolve_birth_time runs the compute API's time endpoint, POST /api/v1/time, with the engine's geo entry and the zone histories it ships, which server.mjs now carries: a local date and time in an IANA zone as UTC and Terrestrial Time, with flags for a time the clocks skipped or repeated, local mean time and a zone history before 1970 that the runtime's own data disputes, and a date written in the Julian calendar up to 1923, with the birth forms' calendar note for a country. search_places searches the site's birthplace index, derived from GeoNames cities15000 under CC BY 4.0, which server.mjs now carries, with the site's ranking. For a place of the Zodiacs time atlas 0.1.0 (CC BY 4.0), which server.mjs also carries, resolve_birth_time adds the atlas's cited reading of the same wall time, with its uncertainty flag, beside tzdb's. server.mjs grows to about 2.5 MB. get_capabilities adds a time and a places section, and its limits and citation text name the two tools; the other tools' arguments, results and receipts are rc.23's. Older archives remain unchanged. The adapter itself is still not on npm.
